metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for collection-based test data injection into Flink DataStreams. It differs semantically and operationally from peer candidates (file reading, text tokenization) and existing skills (thread pool execution, worker lifecycle). No existing skill covers the specific capability of injecting in-memory Java collections/iterators as DataStream sources for isolated unit testing. Support evidence confirms this is a documented Flink pattern. Asset type, granularity, and domain are consistent with the registry layer.
